race.comment: SWISS IMPACT (11) was well found in betting on debut last time out over 1000m at Ballarat and she did a reasonable job to hold on for second after showing speed throughout. Great chance to go one better with the race experience now on board. INDIGO SMILE (3) is an I Am Invincible first starter from the Hayes stable. Has been to no less than six jump-outs since February, winning the latest at Flemington. Looks to have enough talent to compete with this field. SABRINA (9) started at $2.80 but pulled up lame last start at Kyneton so forget that result. Draws a nice gate and can improve at just her third race start. LUNETTA (4) is a newcomer who is going extra well at the jump-outs. Big chance from a highly respected stable. Pre-post favourite RUSSIAN MOONLITE (6) is also lining up for the first time. Recent Ballarat jump-out winner who will certainly get better as he gets out in trip.
